description:
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, putting it under Grinning Ignus.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it and Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
